research_brief: I am planning to purchase comprehensive home property insurance next month for my seaside house and belongings located in Xiamen, Fujian. The estimated total value of my household property (including furniture, electronic equipment, and smart home devices) is approximately ¥300,000, and my annual premium budget is ¥3,000 to ¥5,000. I need a detailed comparative analysis and specific product recommendations from major insurance companies in China based on the following criteria: 1. Disaster Coverage & Coastal Risks: Given the seaside location in Xiamen, evaluate the necessity, availability, policy terms, sub-limits, and deductibles for special endorsements/coverage against natural disasters, specifically earthquakes, floods, and typhoons/coastal storms. 2. Core Risk Protections & Special Clauses: Compare specific insurance products covering fire, theft, and accidental damage. Identify any special clauses, exclusions, depreciation rules, or claim limits relevant to my ¥300,000 household property (electronics, high-end furniture, smart home devices). 3. Claims Processing & Efficiency: Evaluate claims handling convenience, digital/app-based claims submission processes, payout turnaround speed, and guarantees provided by each company. 4. Value-Added Services: Identify supplementary services included in the policy, such as regular property safety inspections, loss prevention advice, property risk assessments, and home emergency assistance. 5. Product Options & Comparison: Recommend specific product packages from reputable insurers within my ¥300,000 property value and ¥3,000–¥5,000 annual budget, comparing key terms, coverage limits, premiums, and claims services. Prioritize primary sources such as official insurance company policy documents and official corporate websites.

research_topics.topic_text: Comprehensive product comparison and policy analysis for high-end home property insurance (中国家庭财产保险/家财险) offered by major Chinese insurers (specifically PICC 人保财险, Ping An 平安产险, CPIC 太平洋财产保险, Sunshine Insurance 阳光财险, and AXA Tianping 亚大天平) for a seaside property in Xiamen, Fujian. Focus on packages and customizable policies within an annual premium budget of 3,000 RMB to 5,000 RMB and household contents / indoor property value of approximately 300,000 RMB. Research coverage limits for building structure, interior renovation/decoration, and household contents (furniture, consumer electronics, smart home equipment). Examine policy terms regarding fire, lightning, explosion, theft, and accidental damage to smart home/electronic devices, along with single-item claim limits, depreciation rules, and specific policy exclusions.

Analysis of coastal disaster endorsements, claims handling efficiency, and value-added services for home property insurance (家财险) in Xiamen, Fujian, China. Research how major insurers (PICC, Ping An, CPIC, Sunshine) handle natural disaster coverage in coastal Fujian, specifically for typhoons, rainstorms, floods, storm surges, and earthquakes (endorsement requirements, special deductibles, regional coastal exclusions, sub-limits). Evaluate digital claims submission processes (via apps/WeChat mini-programs), claim payout turnarounds, claim documentation requirements, and value-added services (such as home risk assessment, property safety inspections, emergency plumbing/locksmith/electrical repairs, and disaster prevention services) included in high-tier home insurance plans.
